title: Tenant config
description: The settings of a tenant of the charge point management system.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the config. A stored config is only replaced by a config of the same or a higher version.

default_security_profile.title: Default security profile
default_security_profile.description: The OCPP security profile of a charge station that is registered without one. SP1 is basic authentication without TLS, SP2 is basic authentication over TLS, SP3 is TLS with a client certificate.

accepted_cert_org_names.title: Accepted certificate organisations
accepted_cert_org_names.description: The organisation names (O) that are accepted in the client certificate of a charge station. With an empty list the organisation of a certificate is not checked.

heartbeat_interval_s.title: Heartbeat interval
heartbeat_interval_s.description: The seconds between two heartbeats of a charge station. Without it the interval of the deployment applies, which is 300 unless the deployment changed it.

default_tariff_ref.title: Default tariff
default_tariff_ref.description: The tariff that applies where no other tariff is set.

onboarding_mode.title: Onboarding of charge stations
onboarding_mode.description: What happens to a charge station that connects without being registered: pending_approval keeps it until somebody approves it, preregistered_only refuses it.
